# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- For VDeskSwitcher, implement only the requested stage, avoid extra features (tray, edge detection, overlay), keep code clear with short comments, and do not delete anything outside the project.
- For DeskOverview, preserve existing edge-switching behavior when changing UI/lifecycle. Keep code minimal and readable, remove unused code/packages/templates, expose only requested settings, retain guarded COM/SendInput fallback, mutex, and PerMonitorV2 DPI awareness.
